description: List members of a GitLab project. Search project members by name or username. Use `list_group_members` for a group.

include_inheritance.description: Include inherited members. Defaults to false.

jmespath.description: Optional JMESPath expression filtering the JSON result before return.

per_page.description: Number of items per page (default: 20, max: 100)

query.description: Search for members by name or username

summary.description: If true, return only high-signal fields (id, iid, title, state, web_url, …). Default false keeps the full GitLab JSON.

name: list_project_members
